items.title: Jack Sheldon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I worked a lot with George Segal.

ctx.x: He’s good for a movie star.
They got their own way of playing, movie stars. You play a little, you pose a little. I worked a lot with George Segal.
George Segal, heck of a banjo player, isn’t he?
